headline: Unusually high use with a persistent baseline draw
explanation: Your bill is {{bill_total}}, up {{bill_change}}; daily use rose {{daily_change}} across billing periods of {{feb_days}} and {{march_days}}. Use is above peers by {{peer_difference}}; the comparison average is {{peer_kwh}} across {{peer_count}} homes in the {{peer_size_range}} size range. The minimum draw of {{minimum_draw}}, versus a prior night baseline of {{baseline_night}}, and a step of {{baseline_step}} beginning {{signal_start}} support a constant-draw anomaly but do not identify its source. Weather is not a reliable explanation: the residual is {{weather_residual}}, the fit is weak, and conditions extend beyond the training range. {{best_plan}} is lowest cost at {{best_plan_total}}, with savings of {{plan_savings}}, so no switch is warranted.
actions: Ask the utility to review meter and interval data beginning {{signal_start}}; compare it with household schedule or equipment changes.
